page_number.meaning: page of the trial sheet (as in the manifest)

scan_index.meaning: position of the page in the given scan

page_code_read.meaning: page code squares read from the scan (1 = filled)

page_code_expected.meaning: page code the manifest gives this page

orientation.meaning: clockwise quarter-turn of the page in the scan (0, 90, 180, 270)

fit_error_mm.meaning: largest miss between a found corner marker and where the other three markers put it

paper.gray.meaning: mean gray of the blank paper areas

paper.rgb.meaning: mean colour of the blank paper areas, unstretched

black.gray.meaning: mean gray of the solid black patch

black.rgb.meaning: mean colour of the solid black patch, unstretched

paper_to_black_contrast.meaning: paper gray minus black gray: the full printable range

gray_patches.level.meaning: gray the patch was meant to print

gray_patches.measured.meaning: mean printed gray of the patch

gray_patches.std.meaning: standard deviation of the printed gray within the patch (noise, banding)

cells_used.meaning: data cells measured (cells under a box mark's outline are left out)

paper_white_share.meaning: share of cells printed within 0.04 of the paper gray

full_black_share.meaning: share of cells printed within 0.04 of the black patch gray

intended_levels.meaning: intended grays grouped into 16 levels: how many of those levels the panel uses

printed_levels.meaning: how many intended levels stay apart on paper (neighbours closer than 0.02 gray count as one)

collapsed_levels.meaning: intended levels minus printed levels: gray levels that merge on paper (summed over panels for a candidate)

correlation.meaning: correlation of printed with intended cell grays (mean over panels for a candidate)

mean_abs_difference.meaning: mean absolute difference between printed and intended cell grays

contrast.meaning: 95th minus 5th percentile of the printed cell grays (mean over panels for a candidate)

intended_contrast.meaning: 95th minus 5th percentile of the intended cell grays

focus.inside_mean.meaning: mean printed gray of the cells inside the focus box

focus.rest_mean.meaning: mean printed gray of the other cells

focus.difference.meaning: focus inside_mean minus rest_mean on paper

focus.intended_difference.meaning: the same difference in the intended grays

mapping.gamma.meaning: gamma of the data-to-gray mapping (1 = linear)

mapping.dark_level.meaning: gray the mapping gives the lowest data (fixed, not tuned)

mapping.light_level.meaning: gray the mapping gives the highest data (fixed, not tuned)

mapping.steps.meaning: number of gray steps (below 2 = smooth; fixed, not tuned)

focus_difference.meaning: panel name -> focus.difference of that panel
